summary: One step; its Proof starts server.js on a temporary data file and checks a group POST, so it runs at S1's done before the test stage writes test/service.test.js.

criteria.text: R-1: concurrent expense writes to one process persist across restart without loss. Confirm by: TC_1 HTTP test; pass when every expense number and the restarted balances match.
R-2 and R-5: groups are created and rejected with the specified statuses. Confirm by: TC_2 HTTP test; pass when 201, 409 and 400 cases match.
R-3 and R-4: expenses split and settle as specified. Confirm by: TC_3 HTTP test; pass when shares, balances and settlements match.
